posts.text:
Sample invoice: Sample Freelancer bills Sample Client USD 750 for a documentation project.

#SAMPLE-016, issued November 16, 2026, due November 30. Currency: USD.
posts.alt: Invoice Generator sample header: invoice SAMPLE-016 from Sample Freelancer to Sample Client, issued November 16, 2026, due November 30, 2026. The invoice is denominated in USD and marked as a sample, not payable.

posts.text:
Sample line item 1: Documentation draft (hours).
Quantity 12 x rate USD 50 = USD 600.

Put 'hours' in Description. The generator has Quantity and Rate fields, with no separate hours selector.
posts.alt: Sample invoice row in the Invoice Generator: Documentation draft (hours), quantity 12, rate USD 50, total USD 600. The unit 'hours' appears in Description; there is no separate hours selector.

posts.text:
Sample line item 2: Revision and handoff (hours).
Quantity 4 x rate USD 50 = USD 200. Use Add Item for the second row.

USD 600 draft + USD 200 handoff = USD 800 subtotal.
posts.alt: Two sample invoice rows: Documentation draft, 12 hours at USD 50, totals USD 600. Revision and handoff, 4 hours at USD 50, totals USD 200. Combined subtotal: USD 800.

posts.text:
Sample inputs: Tax (%) = 0; Discount (flat) = 50.
USD 800 + USD 0 - USD 50 = USD 750.

The discount is USD 50, not 50%. The zero tax rate applies only to this example.
posts.alt: Sample Invoice Generator totals: USD 800 subtotal, minus USD 50 flat discount, equals USD 750. Tax is set to 0% for this example; the preview omits the zero tax row.

posts.text:
Sample payment terms: Currency USD; Payment Method USDC on Ethereum mainnet.

Notes: settle 750 USDC at an agreed 1 USD = 1 USDC. This is an example agreement; the tool does not convert currencies.
posts.alt: Sample invoice payment notes: USD 750 billed, with example settlement of 750 USDC on Ethereum mainnet at an agreed 1 USD = 1 USDC. Payment Method and Notes are text fields; the tool does not convert currencies. The wallet field is empty and the sample is not payable.

posts.text:
Sample invoice #SAMPLE-016 totals USD 750, due November 30, 2026. Download PDF exports the invoice and payment notes.

The wallet field is empty; this sample is not payable.
